answer: A trading platform can limit fraudulent refund claims by attaching the claim right to a settled order. A jade purchase or a raven survey from a ledge generates one buyer-signed receipt. The dispute registry allows one active case per receipt and applies every appeal to that same case. Rotating buyer keys cannot multiply refunds or freeze the seller repeatedly. A farm must fund distinct settled purchases and pay their fees to create more claims. Independent adjudication is still needed to judge delivery.
